article_context: The body image introduces the section about wanting to live by the river. It presents the long embankment beside Level Prichalny as an everyday setting for walks, running, fresh air, and quiet recreation close to home.
image_reading: A modern residential complex dominates the middle distance beside a broad river, with trees and an embankment across the foreground.
A passenger riverboat is already moving toward the right, leaving a visible wake; the water, wake, and foliage are the naturally movable elements.
The open blue sky and layered riverside composition create a calm, spacious urban setting.

models.positive_prompt: The riverboat travels steadily to the right while its wake broadens and ripples across the water. Keep the camera fixed on the riverside complex; by the final frame, the boat is farther right and remains fully visible with a long fading wake behind it.
models.scene_plan: Five-second fixed-camera shot centered on the residential complex and river. The boat immediately continues its moderate rightward passage through the lower frame; its wake lengthens, spreads, and softens across the water while foliage moves only slightly. Near the end, the boat reaches a clearly farther-right position without leaving the frame, with the extended wake visibly settling behind it.

models.positive_prompt: The boat glides smoothly rightward along the river as a widening wake rolls behind it. A subtle slow push toward the riverside complex keeps the boat and buildings visible; end with the boat farther downstream and its long wake gently dissipating.
models.scene_plan: Use the full five seconds for one continuous downstream glide. The boat advances right at an even, unhurried speed while successive wake ripples spread outward and gradually lose intensity. Apply one minimal slow push toward the complex to connect river life with the home setting. Finish with the boat still recognizable near the right side and a long, gently dissipating wake marking its path.

models.positive_prompt: With a fixed camera, the riverboat moves steadily to the right and draws a widening wake across the water. End with the boat still fully visible farther right and the trailing ripples beginning to settle beneath the riverside homes.
models.scene_plan: A focused four-second fixed view. The boat promptly advances rightward with moderate motion, and the wake expands in a clean continuous pattern that supplies most of the environmental movement. The shorter scene ends as the boat reaches a noticeably farther-right position, still fully in frame, while the nearest wake ripples begin to flatten.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Life at Level Prichalny combines a modern home with calm, accessible riverside recreation just outside it.
structured_intent.primary_action: The riverboat continues traveling downstream, extending and spreading its wake across the water.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The scene remains a calm, inviting view of everyday life beside the residential complex and river.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The boat is visibly farther to the right while remaining in frame, with a long wake behind it beginning to dissipate.
